data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an opening gross claims outstanding of 554.9m and a net prior-year release with gross prior-year provisions reduced by GBP 18.0m in 2014. The release reflects favourable claims development and the effects of portfolio re-underwriting; however the calendar year results were impacted by large aviation war losses (eg Tripoli Airport attack) and reserve strengthening in the General Liability/ casualty book. Overall the prior year movement reported is a modest release of c.GBP 18m on gross reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount sourced from the note text stating a "decrease in 2014 of previous provisions of GBP 18.0m". The note header refers to change in provision for claims and discusses insurer/reinsurer shares; the text excerpt appears to be aggregate but is labelled in the notes as a net movement in places - there is ambiguity whether the quoted GBP 18.0m is gross or net in surrounding context. No explicit gross prior-year movement table (insurance liabilities column) or claims development triangle was available to independently corroborate the gross PYD. Reinsurance to close activity (RITC) for 2012 is noted elsewhere and may distort development tables had they been present.
